description: Ministry of Defence - Prohibit the navigation of any unmanned air craft or any drone
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Defence exercising powers under the Civil Aviation Act to prohibit the navigation of unmanned aircraft and drones in Sri Lankan airspace. This constitutes a regulatory action based on existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title, and the core content is about implementing a regulatory prohibition under statutory authority.
